description: Follows a URL hop by hop (up to 15) without loading the final page's content: status, Location, timing and server for each hop, final URL, and flags for loops, too many hops, HTTPS-to-HTTP downgrades, cross-domain jumps, suspected open redirects, and meta-refresh redirects. Use on short links or tracking links before opening them. Price: $0.005 USDC on Base per successful call (x402).
name: redirects
title: Redirect chain tracer
